literal: Whatever thing, of whatever nature even if it is, of that thing the true substance seeing is wisdom.
translation: Whatever the thing may be and whatever its nature, wisdom is seeing the true substance of that thing.
modern: எந்தப் பொருள் எந்தத் தன்மையைக் கொண்டிருந்தாலும், அந்தப் பொருளின் உண்மையான தன்மையைக் காண்பதே மெய்யறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines true wisdom as the ability to see past the surface of things. The phrase 'epporul ettanmaittu ayinum' acknowledges that things in the world present themselves in countless forms and appearances. However, 'meypporul' refers to the underlying truth or reality of those things. True knowledge, therefore, is not distracted by outward characteristics but penetrates to the core reality of whatever it encounters.
